summary: Develop practical REIT skills in fund governance, valuation, financing and investor reporting. Explore the course and build property-fund tools.
lede: REIT and real-estate fund training covers assessing property vehicles, fund governance, asset management and investor reporting. It is for fund managers, investment teams, developers, asset managers, analysts, trustees, valuers and regulators who need to make and oversee decisions using property and fund data. Participants practise property screening and valuation review, financing and distribution analysis, and governance checks with investor reporting.
audienceIntro: This REIT and property-fund course is designed for professionals who assess, operate, oversee or report on pooled real-estate investments. It suits people with working exposure to property, investment analysis, fund administration or financial oversight.
modules: REIT Tax Risk and Implementation Plan
prerequisites: Working familiarity with real estate, investment analysis, fund operations or financial reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel for spreadsheet-based exercises; Power BI experience is helpful but not required.
